answer.evidence: The bush is one rounded mound. The silhouette widens from 5 px at row 9 to about 30 px by row 20 and stays wide to row 27, then tapers to 8 px at row 30. The upper rows 9-16 are the lightest greens (L=103, #497f3c) and read as the lit upper surface of the heap. Below that, rows 17-29 step darker (L=78, then 55, then 36 and 22) and form the shaded front mass with a dark base. There is no hard front-edge line or eave shadow, because foliage shades gradually. Even so, the light top and the dark front give a top-plus-front volume, so it reads as three_quarter and not as a flat front elevation. The top call is soft: it rests only on the lighter top rows.
